guards: source-pin: fails if the meter's BG_WORDS/DISPOSITIONS literals drift (exit 4)
refuses a province that is not UTF-8 round-trip clean (a raw-byte sha could not match the meter's re-encoding path, exit 4)
refuses a TSV cell carrying a tab or newline

fresh_run.note: --rev defaults to the lane HEAD (the freeze commit at the L1's run); the map is read from that rev, never from the worktree

meter_dryrun.note: the fixture repo is a scratch-only git repo holding corpus/adjacency.tsv at ef43ece plus the two candidate ledgers; the meter reads them by rev through git, exactly as it will read the data commit. Run against the FINAL v17 bytes (sha256 7305b672…).
